notes.title: Army General Update to 1.04
notes.notes:
Update 1.04 - 10th June 2021

Thanks to those in the Steam community who helped to improve Army General with their constructive critisism!

Added:

- Unit history with kills counted and destroyed unit names stored
- Script Editor: in the tab "Map" you can now see which resolution a map has to have to be 1:1 pixel onscreen (no interpolation)
- Editor: flags in unit list for better identification
- Expanded several tooltips of support units (InfBn, TankBn, AABn and ArtBn)
- Link button to Germany at War in the main menu
- Button to study the update history of Army General 

Fixed:

- Game and editor crashed, if too many entries for "resources per turn" were made
- Combat prediction was inaccurate in some cases if canons were involved
- Combat value preview was wrong in HQ during addition of support units (Anduril)
- Cost preview in the improvement menu showed wrong value in some cases
- Game crashed if you took a screenshot from a savegame if the included scenario was not on your computer
- In Mission4 the normal victory was not triggered and the game counted it as a loss (Panzer Tobruk)
- Several typos across the game
- Steam: Port master achievement could not be triggered
- Steam: Tutorial achievement was not triggered
- Mission2: German texts instead of English ones were in the Axis objectives
- Battleaxe: even after achieving the goals for air supremacy you still got a negative comment from Halder (Panzer Tobruk)
- 2nd El Alamein: no BV was possible (Panzer Tobruk)
- Script Editor: you could select nations not availble in Army General which lead to a crash when the map was loaded. (Wakanda)

Changed:

- Rebalanced Mission 1-4 (Panzer Tobruk)
- Missions 2-4 now have free rule selection (Panzer Tobruk)

notes.title: Update 1.03 released
notes.notes:
Fixed:

- supply fields of the enemy were not displayed in the editor
- units with vehicles could be airborned
- scrolling was choppy
- AI equips support units before the first human turn
- Recruitment could be reached with shortcut even if it was not possible in a scenario
- "destroyed" marker did not disappear after railbridge was repaired
- bridges could not bridge sea or lake hexes
- some tutorials had wrong indicator in scenario list
- victory condition in Raid on Alexandria was faulty
- STEAM: tutorial achievement adjusted to 5 


Editor:

Fixed:

- transports are not deleted if you switch unit types

notes.title: Army General version 1.02 released
notes.notes:
Update 1.02 19th June 2017

Added:

- US Army arrived!
- 18x new US officers
- 15x new US equipment:

	Infantry:

		-Regular 39
		-Paratroops
		-Mountain troops
		-Bridging engineers
		-Assault enginners

	Tanks:
		
		-M3 Lee
		-M3 Grant
		-M3 Stuart
		-M4 Sherman

	Anti-tank:

		-M10

	Artillery:

		-M7 Priest

	Scouts:

		-M8 Greyhound
		-M20 Scout car

	Anti-air:

		-M13 MGMC
		-M15 CGMC

- 1x new German officer: E.Rommel
- 1x new British officer: B.Montgomery
- U-boats have better cover in rain: +2 defence for German u-boats until better radar and leigh light is introduced by the Allies in June 1942
- "Torpedo crisis '39/'40" - 50% chance for German u-boats for -5 on attack
- naval units in ports have a penalty on strength -7 (lancelot2001ca)
- "End turn" window now has option to turn it off (Herodotus)
- tutorial mission 5 for learning how to counter artillery support (Herodotus)
- combat modifikator for transports now in the tooltips (Dr.Who619)

Fixed:

- air units sometimes turned to ships (Ranko)
- NATO Symbols of German wagon and halftrack was wrong
- MG company was not avaible as support unit

Script Editor: 
- values for forced preset could not be put to games' maximum

Changed:

- balancing of land - sea attacks

notes.title: Update to 1.01 now out on Steam
notes.notes:
Buttons to access the manual and the script editor from the game as well as many fixes are included in this update.
Here is the complete list of the changes:

Update 1.01 16th May 2017

Added:
- button to launch manual from main menu
- button to launch script editor from main menu
- hint if units cannot be placed after the deploy phase (Anduril)

Fixed:

- crashed at Gazala (April 1941) after reinforcements arrived (poppppel38)
- British reinforcements at Gazala were placed outside the map
- land units as reinforcements on sea hexes did not arrive in sea transports (Gloo)
- Malta OKW favour could not be achieved
- Malta Axis 2nd invasion wave did not trigger correctly
- Conquest of Tobruk +10 strength to Allies to make victory always possible (CaesarCzech)
- wrong branching after defeat at Conquest of Tobruk (CaesarCzech)
- hint before Battleaxe that units will be united to one army again (rick_d)
- hints contain wrong infos about refreshing at map start (Anduril)

Changed:

- added 2nd British reinforcement with ships at Malta
